script.title: HELPING WITH GROCERIES
script.scene_zh: 超市門口 · 幫忙提重物
script.story_hook: A dropped grocery bag brings two strangers together.
script.intro_zh: 打翻的購物袋讓兩個陌生人互相認識。
script.welcome_en: Hello friends, so glad you're here! Today we're helping a stranger at the grocery store.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，很高興你們在這裡！今天我們來練習在超市外幫助陌生人。
script.outro: Kindness counts! Listen again and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 善意最珍貴！再聽一遍，我們下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice! Echo each sentence with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間到！跟著我一句一句複誦。
script.char_a_description: a silver-haired man in his sixties with a neat mustache and reading glasses on a cord, wearing a navy flat cap, an olive quilted vest over a flannel shirt, carefully balancing two overflowing paper bags
script.char_b_description: a bright-eyed college-age woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length chestnut hair and straight bangs, wearing an oversized gray university hoodie, jeans and white sneakers, holding a reusable tote bag
script.youtube_title: 【🛒陌生人幫忙提東西】「多虧你」怎麼說？🍊客氣拒絕與真誠道謝實戰英文✨｜Grocery Help English
script.youtube_title_en: "You Saved My Day" — Helping Carry Groceries
script.youtube_description:
路人掉了東西，你要怎麼用英文開口幫忙？對方一直客氣地說不用，又該怎麼接話？這集從購物袋破掉的那一刻開始，練習「let me help」、「I couldn't take that」、「thank you, you saved my day」最真實的來回互動。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完下次遇到同樣情況也能熱心開口！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Someone's grocery bag just ripped in the parking lot — what do you say in English? This warm little scene teaches you how to offer help, how to politely refuse, and how to thank someone like a native. You'll hear real back-and-forth like "Let me help you pick these up", "I couldn't take your bag", and "You saved my day". 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, followed by a repeat-after-me drill.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🛒幫提重物英文｜開口幫忙・客氣拒絕・真誠道謝｜聽完就會幫助人｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看到陌生人購物袋破了，你敢開口用英文幫忙嗎？
對方一直說不用，又該怎麼接話？

這一集帶大家走進超市門口的停車場，從柳橙撒了一地開始，練習主動提協助、客氣地婉拒、最後真誠道謝，還收到一顆蘋果的小小心意。

你會聽到：
🍊 開口幫忙：例如「Let me help you pick these up.」、「use my tote bag instead」。
🙅 客氣婉拒：例如「That's very kind, but it's just a few oranges.」、「I couldn't take your bag.」。
💛 真誠道謝：例如「Thank you so much, you saved my day.」、「Drive safe and have a good evening.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把善意的英文說得自然又溫暖。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次看見有人需要幫忙，你已經知道第一句該怎麼說了！
script.thumbnail_action: carrying a paper grocery bag full of oranges

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the bag just ripped open!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə bæɡ dʒʌst rɪpt ˈoʊpən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you okay? Let me help you pick these up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈoʊkeɪ lɛt mi hɛlp ju pɪk ðiz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你還好嗎？我幫你把它們撿起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's very kind, but it's just a few oranges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈvɛri kaɪnd bʌt ɪts dʒʌst ə fju ˈɔrəndʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 你人太好了，不過就是幾顆柳橙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, use my tote bag instead, it's stronger.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr juz maɪ toʊt bæɡ ɪnˈstɛd ɪts ˈstrɔŋgər/
dialogue.zh: 用我的提袋吧，它比較結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I couldn't take your bag, miss.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ kʊdnt teɪk jɔr bæɡ mɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這怎麼好意思拿你的袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's nothing really, I always carry this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈrɪli aɪ ˈɔlweɪz ˈkæri ˈðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我平常都帶著這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thank you so much, you saved my day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl θæŋk ju sɑˈmʌʧ ju seɪvd maɪ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就太謝謝你了，今天多虧你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem! Where's your car parked?
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！你的車停在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right across the street, it's a bit of a walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt əˈkrɔs ðə strit ɪts ə bɪt əv ə wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 就在對面那條街，還要走一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These cans look heavy, I'll carry the top box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz kænz lʊk ˈhɛvi aɪl ˈkæri ðə tɑp bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這些罐頭看起來很重，我提上面這箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You don't have to, I'm older but not that old!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju doʊnt həv tə aɪm ˈoʊldər bʌt nɑt ðæt oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 不用啦，我只是上年紀，沒那麼老！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Fair enough, but let me grab one bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛr ɪˈnʌf bət lɛt mi ɡræb wʌn bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！說得也是，讓我幫你拿一袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're too kind, young lady. I'm Frank, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr tu kaɪnd jʌŋ ˈleɪdi aɪm fræŋk baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你真是太好了，小姐。對了，我叫法蘭克。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Frank. I'm Rosa. Almost there?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə ˈmiʨu fræŋk aɪm ˈroʊzə ˈɔlmost ðɪr/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，法蘭克。我叫蘿莎。快到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, this red one. Can you hit the remote?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs rɛd wʌn kæn ju hɪt ðə rɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 對，這台紅色的。能幫我按一下車鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure... beep! There you go, all loaded.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr bip ðɛr ju ɡoʊ ɔl ˈloʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 好啊……嗶！開鎖了，都放進去囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set. Here, please take these apples.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt hɪr pliz teɪk ðiz ˈæpəlz/
dialogue.zh: 都搞定了。來，請帶幾顆蘋果回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, thanks, Frank! Drive safe and have a good evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋks fræŋk draɪv seɪf ənd hæv ə ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 喔，謝謝你法蘭克！路上小心，晚安。
